info.title: EXCLURAD request with invalid cos θ* = 1.3

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.0, cos theta* = 1.3, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

I’m validating the requested kinematics first. The supplied `cos(theta*) = 1.3` is outside the physical range `[-1, 1]`, so generation should not proceed unless the validator identifies a safe, explicit correction.

The preflight check rejects the point because `cos(theta*) = 1.3` is outside the physical cosine range `[-1, 1]`. I will record a refusal and produce no EXCLURAD input file rather than silently clamp the value.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["invalid_cos_theta"],"explanation":"Request refused: cos(theta*) = 1.3 is physically invalid because a cosine must lie in [-1, 1]. The value should not be clamped automatically; provide a corrected cos(theta*) value before generating EXCLURAD input."}
*** End Patch
